Manipur Violence Erupts Again, 9 Dead in Kamjong and Kangpokpi

Violence has again erupted in Manipur, resulting in the deaths of nine people in the Kamjong and Kangpokpi districts. Chief Minister N. Biren Singh has appealed for peace amidst the renewed unrest. The renewed violence raises questions about the effectiveness of ongoing efforts to restore peace in the state.
